title: Record the relay that carries each matched source into its target
body:
## Summary
- Under the channel's addition rule, all 208 published flags deliver their source value into the matched target. The final coefficient is 1/2 for 153 flags and -1/2 for 55. Every delivery is at or after that source's first event.
- X0 is first touched at event 591. Its value reaches Y34 at event 2815 with coefficient 1/2, through G0, Q0, C and D17.
- The Gram identity for that coefficient is not recomputed, and there is no new exponent.
